translations.web: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth; for the people feared the oath.
translations.bsb: And when they entered the forest and saw the flowing honey, not one of them put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.
translations.kjv: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.
translations.asv: And when the people were come unto the forest, behold, the honey dropped: but no man put his hand to his mouth; for the people feared the oath.
